items.name: U.S. Destroyer Practices Underway Refueling with Seahawk USV
items.summary: A U.S. destroyer refueled an Unmanned Surface Vessel earlier this month in the Pacific as part of the Navy’s latest development effort to hone at-sea drone sustainment, the sea service announced Monday. USS Chafee (DDG-90) conducted an at-sea fueling of Seahawk, a Medium Displacement USV on Sept. 11, according to photos released Monday by the Navy. The astern refueling method was previously tested between Seahawk and oiler USNS Guadalupe (T-AO 200) in April. The April refueling of the MDUSV was “critical to deployed operations of MUSVs in conjunction with a carrier strike group,” Military Sealift Command said in a statement
